name: Kayse Jama

bio.statement: Her official page describes Jama as a former refugee, Black Muslim and Somali-American serving in the Senate.
bio.excerpt: It is a lifetime honor of mine to be the first former refugee, Black Muslim and Somali-American to serve

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: Her official page lists Jama as Chair of the Senate Rules Committee.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Jama lists his occupation as Oregon state senator, with a background as a nonprofit leader.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Oregon State Senator Occupational Background: Nonprofit Leader

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

bio.statement: Jama lists a B.A. from Marylhurst University.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

bio.statement: Jama lists Oregon Senate Majority Leader, chair of the Senate Committee on Housing and Development and the Oregon Commission on Black Affairs.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Oregon Senate Majority Leader; Chair, Senate Committee on Housing & Development; Oregon Commission on Black Affairs

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: In an October 2026 OPB report, Jama said affordability and economic opportunity are crucial to her constituents and all Oregonians.
positions.excerpt: Affordability and economic opportunity are crucial in the lives of my constituents and the lives of all Oregonians.

source.publisher: OPB

positions.statement: Jama says he is focused on lowering everyday costs, building affordable housing, expanding health care access and investing in clean energy.
positions.excerpt: I’m focused on lowering everyday costs, building more affordable housing, expanding access to healthcare, and investing in clean energy that protects Oregon’s environment.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Jama says he will defend reproductive healthcare access, protect LGBTQ+ rights and keep Oregon welcoming to immigrants and refugees.
positions.excerpt: I will continue defending access to reproductive healthcare, protecting LGBTQ+ rights, and ensuring Oregon remains a welcoming home for immigrants and refugees.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Jama says he will keep fighting for classroom investment, support for educators and opportunity for every student.
positions.excerpt: I will keep fighting for classroom investment, support for educators, and opportunity for every student.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Jama cites expanding access to free and low-cost childcare as a past result.
positions.excerpt: Expanded access to free and low-cost childcare

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 44

positions.statement: Jama's campaign website describes SB 1530 as targeted investments designed to keep Oregonians in their homes.
positions.excerpt: targeted investments designed to keep Oregonians in their homes.

source.publisher: Kayse Jama campaign website (Homelessness)

positions.statement: Jama's campaign website says equity-focused education programs and services should not be cut.
positions.excerpt: we need to keep this promise and not let our investments in equity-focused programs and services fall by the wayside.

source.publisher: Kayse Jama campaign website (Education)

positions.statement: Jama's campaign website describes a 2024 Student Success Plan for immigrant and refugee students as catered to their unique needs.
positions.excerpt: catered to the unique needs of immigrant and refugee students

source.publisher: Kayse Jama campaign website (Education)
